Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting No. - 37
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament,
2083 Ashadh 30, Tuesday
11:00 AM
Presentation of Annual Reports
On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam:
(a) "Annual Report of the Judicial Council, Fiscal Year 2081/082" will be presented.
(b) "Annual Report of the Judicial Service Commission, Fiscal Year 2081/082" will be presented.
(c) "61st Annual Report of the Public Service Commission (2081 Shrawan - 2082 Ashadh)" will be presented.
Legislative Business
On behalf of the Honourable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle:
(a) Will present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Bill to Amend and Repeal Some Nepal Laws Related to Finance, 2083".
(b) Will introduce the "Bill to Amend and Repeal Some Nepal Laws Related to Finance, 2083".
On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balen Shah, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam:
(a) Will present a proposal to "Send the Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, 2083" to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion.
(b) Will present a proposal to "Send the National Service Corps Bill, 2083" to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.summary_en: The Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, presented the annual reports of the Judicial Council, the Judicial Service Commission, and the Public Service Commission for the fiscal year 2081/082.
